source: hand-typed from the publishers' own pages
note: There is no machine-readable feed for the SAT or ACT calendar anywhere. Every row in administrations.csv was read by a human from the page named in its own dates_source_url / score_release_source_url column on checked_on, and is committed so that a refresh is reviewable in a diff. Past expires_on the coach refuses to name a date and points at the publishers; a test fails when any row is within 90 days of expires_on or past it.
